To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

trust and perceived usefulness are positively related to customer satisfaction; mobility is positively related to customer trust; customization is positively related to mobility; customization positively moderates the influence between mobility and customer satisfaction, and customization positively moderates customer trust.
the main antecedents of m-commerce customer satisfaction are trust, perceived usefulness, and mobility.

trust, perceived usefulness, and perceived enjoyment are significant drivers of customer satis-faction, whereas mobility is a significant driver of customer satisfaction in the case of customized m-commerce services.
